capabilities.name: c2.doctrine.effective
capabilities.title: c2.doctrine.effective
capabilities.description: A unit's effective doctrine: every key with its value, the level it comes from (default, side:<s>, group:<g>, unit:v:<id>) and whether it is locked. Needs the BDArmory binding (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE without it).

unit.description: unit: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id, an exact unit name, or "active".

capabilities.name: c2.doctrine.set
capabilities.title: c2.doctrine.set
capabilities.description: Sets doctrine at side, group or unit level (09 §11.1), e.g. values {weaponsControl:"tight", onContact:"engage", advanceOnContact:false, pauseOnFirstLaunch:true}. lock makes keys binding for lower levels. Nothing changes on error; a key locked higher up fails with reason locked_by:side|group. Needs the BDArmory binding (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE without it).

target.description: side name, group name, or unit reference; defaults to the session's side for level side

values.description: doctrine keys and values (strings, numbers, booleans)

lock.description: keys to lock at this level

capabilities.name: c2.doctrine.unset
capabilities.title: c2.doctrine.unset
capabilities.description: Removes doctrine keys (and their locks) at one level so the next level up applies again. Needs the BDArmory binding (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE without it).

target.description: side name, group name, or unit reference; defaults to the session's side for level side

capabilities.name: c2.order.cancel
capabilities.title: c2.order.cancel
capabilities.description: Cancels an order and all its unit orders; an engagement order gives units back their movement order. Needs the BDArmory binding (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE without it).

order.description: order handle o:<id> (or the bare id)

capabilities.name: c2.order.issue
capabilities.title: c2.order.issue
capabilities.description: Issues an order to units, a group or a whole side (09 §2.1). Types: move_to (point, altitudeM), move_route (route), engage (target or targets), hold_pattern (patternA, patternB, widthKm, turnRight, altStackM), rtb (base, weapons), defend_unit (protect, radiusKm), escort (escortOf, slot, distanceKm), attack_nearest, all_attack (scope side). Returns the order handle o:<id>, a summary line and per-unit outcomes; a whole-order refusal is an error whose reason is the refusal code (not_own_side, hook_missing, winchester, ...). Progress arrives as order.* events. Needs the BDArmory binding (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE without it).

side.description: Issuing side; units of other sides are refused. Defaults to the session's side.

items.description: unit: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id, an exact unit name, or "active".

scope.description: side: every unit of the side (rtb all, all_attack; needs the seat or a referee)

altitudeM.description: aircraft altitude above terrain; omit to keep

target.description: engage target: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id, an exact unit name, or "active".

items.description: target: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id, an exact unit name, or "active".

base.description: rtb base (carrier or airfield unit); omit for the unit's home: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id, an exact unit name, or "active".

weapons.description: rtb weapons control on the way home

protect.description: defend_unit protected unit: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id, an exact unit name, or "active".

escortOf.description: escort leader: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id, an exact unit name, or "active".

extendRange.description: attack_nearest: raise ships' SAM range to the weapon maximum (always on for all_attack)

capabilities.name: c2.side.managed
capabilities.title: c2.side.managed
capabilities.description: Puts a side under Skizzy control (advance on contact, VIP priority, missile engagement, ship SAM priority run without orders) or returns it to plain BDArmory. Orders work for any side either way. Omit managed to read the state. Needs the BDArmory binding (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE without it).

side.description: Side. Defaults to the session's side.

managed.description: true to manage, false to release

capabilities.name: c2.unit.release
capabilities.title: c2.unit.release
capabilities.description: Returns units to plain BDArmory guard behaviour: cancels their orders (with reports) and clears holds. Doctrine still applies. Needs the BDArmory binding (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE without it).

items.description: unit: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id, an exact unit name, or "active".

capabilities.name: c2.unit.status
capabilities.title: c2.unit.status
capabilities.description: What the C2 engine is doing with a unit: task, movement and engagement orders with status, hold, fire authority and filter, override target and stickiness, route, yield/leash, divert, self-defence, advance, VIP threat, weapons control, on-contact. Needs the BDArmory binding (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE without it).

unit.description: unit: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id, an exact unit name, or "active".

capabilities.name: c2.vip.set
capabilities.title: c2.vip.set
capabilities.description: Flags a unit as a VIP (high-value unit) or clears the flag. On a managed side, idle fighters orbit it, ships take station and threats to it get priority (24 rows 21-23). Needs the BDArmory binding (EXECUTOR_UNAVAILABLE without it).

unit.description: unit: a handle "v:<id>", a vessel id, an exact unit name, or "active".

vip.description: true to flag, false to clear

capabilities.name: events.poll
capabilities.title: events.poll
capabilities.description: Reads events from the host's ring buffer (8192 events) after `cursor`. Namespaces: vessel.*, sim.*, host.*, rec.*. Returns {events, nextCursor, resyncRequired}. Use nextCursor in the next call.

cursor.description: return events with cursor > this; omit for the most recent `limit` events

format.description: "compact" = a few readable text lines (best for LLMs), "json" = structured

capabilities.name: events.wait
capabilities.title: events.wait
capabilities.description: Long-poll: waits up to timeoutS for events after `cursor` that match `names`, then returns them (or an empty list on timeout). MCP has no server push, so agents call this to be woken by game events instead of polling.

cursor.description: wait for events with cursor > this; omit to wait for new events from now

format.description: "compact" = a few readable text lines (best for LLMs), "json" = structured

capabilities.name: host.debug.confirm_test
capabilities.title: host.debug.confirm_test
capabilities.description: Does nothing, but is classified destructive so the user's 'ask' prompt can be tested end to end. Returns {confirmed:true} if approved.

capabilities.name: host.debug.spike
capabilities.title: host.debug.spike
capabilities.description: Runs one of the M0 spikes in the real game and returns measured results: jpg_thread (ImageConversion.EncodeArrayToJPG off the main thread), async_readback (AsyncGPUReadback support and cost on this graphics API), sync_context (UnitySynchronizationContext idle wake latency), nostdlib (assembly references and runtime), or all.

capabilities.name: host.doctor
capabilities.title: host.doctor
capabilities.description: The in-game half of `skizzy doctor`: versions, KSP build, KSPCommunityFixes MemoryLeaks setting, CommNet in the current game, other autopilots (AtmosphereAutopilot, MechJeb, kOS), KJR, PhysicsRangeExtender, Harmony and KSPBurst notes, with green/yellow/red lines.

capabilities.name: host.kill_switch
capabilities.title: host.kill_switch
capabilities.description: Kill switch. action=engage: denies every non-read call from every client, cancels operations and pending confirmations, and shows a banner in game (M1 adds releasing all flight holds). action=release: only from the in-game banner or a human actor. action=status: returns the state. Always allowed to engage.

reason.description: shown in the banner and audit

capabilities.name: host.selfcheck
capabilities.title: host.selfcheck
capabilities.description: Runs the host self-checks and returns pass/warn/fail lines: idle mode (UnitySynchronizationContext wake or polling), registered GameEvents per event, OnFlyByWire callbacks and Harmony patches by Skizzy (must be 0), dispatcher timing, heap slope, M0 spike results, assembly references, and optionally Unity texture/RenderTexture/Material/GameObject counts (textures:true; allocates once).

textures.description: also count Unity textures and objects (slower, allocates once)

capabilities.name: host.selfcheck.perf
capabilities.title: host.selfcheck.perf
capabilities.description: Runs a performance gate (02 §8.3) and reports measured numbers against the budget. gate=idle: per-frame host cost with this client connected and idle (budget < 0.1 ms) plus the last idle-probe result; gate=screenshot: N captures at 1024 px measuring main-thread ms (budget <= 3 ms async readback, <= 30 ms fallback) and Texture2D/RenderTexture counts before/after; gate=log: a synthetic log of `vessels` targets x 3 fields at 10 Hz measuring sampler ms per FixedUpdate (budget <= 0.2 ms). Long-running: returns an op.

captures.description: number of captures for the screenshot gate (100 for the leak check)

vessels.description: log gate: number of vessel targets to sample (loaded vessels are repeated to reach it)

capabilities.name: host.sessions
capabilities.title: host.sessions
capabilities.description: Connected sessions: actor (id, kind, role, side, precedence), client (name, kind, MCP client), age, calls, bytes in/out.

capabilities.name: host.state
capabilities.title: host.state
capabilities.description: Current game state: scene, paused, time scale, warp, active vessel handle and name, UT.

capabilities.name: host.stats
capabilities.title: host.stats
capabilities.description: Host performance and health: dispatcher budget and main-thread time (p50/p99), queue depth, sessions, frame time while active, GC collections, idle mode, screenshot and log sampler timings, auto-disabled capabilities, kill switch state.

capabilities.name: ksp.camera.look_at
capabilities.title: ksp.camera.look_at
capabilities.description: Frames an engagement: the camera sits behind `from` so that `to` is visible beyond it, updated every frame until another camera call.

to.description: far vessel to keep in view

capabilities.name: ksp.camera.orbit
capabilities.title: ksp.camera.orbit
capabilities.description: Sets heading, pitch and distance of the camera around its target (clamped to KSP's limits).

heading.description: degrees, 0 = camera north of target looking south, 180 = astern for a north-bound vessel

capabilities.name: ksp.camera.save
capabilities.title: ksp.camera.save
capabilities.description: Same capture as ksp.camera.screenshot, written to Skizzy/screenshots/<date>/<name>.<ext> under the KSP folder. Returns the path.

name.description: file name stem (letters, digits, - _ .); default is a timestamp

hideUi.description: hide the KSP UI for one frame

target.description: optional vessel to point the camera at first

capabilities.name: ksp.camera.screenshot
capabilities.title: ksp.camera.screenshot
capabilities.description: Takes a screenshot of what the player sees and returns it as an image. Optionally targets a vessel and sets a camera mode and orbit first, in one call (e.g. chase view of DDG-1). Limited to 1 capture per 2 s per session. ~1024 px is enough for an LLM.

hideUi.description: hide the KSP UI for one frame

target.description: optional vessel to point the camera at first (does not change the active vessel)

mode.description: optional camera mode to set first

heading.description: degrees, 0 = camera north of target looking south, 180 = astern for a north-bound vessel

capabilities.name: ksp.camera.set_mode
capabilities.title: ksp.camera.set_mode
capabilities.description: Sets the flight camera mode (13 §1.2): follow (auto mode on the target), orbit (heading/pitch/distance), chase (behind the velocity vector), free (stays in place), look_at (keeps `to` behind the target in view), locked. Never changes the active vessel.

target.description: vessel to target first (default: current camera target)

to.description: look_at: the vessel to keep in view beyond the target

heading.description: degrees, 0 = camera north of target looking south, 180 = astern for a north-bound vessel

capabilities.name: ksp.camera.state
capabilities.title: ksp.camera.state
capabilities.description: Current camera mode, target, heading, pitch, distance and whether look_at is active.

capabilities.name: ksp.camera.target
capabilities.title: ksp.camera.target
capabilities.description: Points the camera at a vessel without changing the active vessel (leases and the human's controls are unaffected).

vessel.description: Vessel: a handle like "v:3281937421", an exact vessel name, or "active" for the vessel the player flies.

capabilities.name: ksp.log.tail
capabilities.title: ksp.log.tail
capabilities.description: Returns the last lines of KSP.log (read from disk; the host never hooks Unity's log). Filter by level or substring.

capabilities.name: ksp.mods.list
capabilities.title: ksp.mods.list
capabilities.description: Lists loaded mod assemblies (name, version, GameData folder, file) and GameData top-level folders.

nameLike.description: glob on assembly or folder name

cursor.description: opaque cursor from a previous result's "cursor" to get the next page

capabilities.name: ksp.module.describe
capabilities.title: ksp.module.describe
capabilities.description: Describes a part module type (Tier 0): its KSPFields with JSON Schema types, ranges and units from the UI controls, whether each is shown in the part action window, plus events and actions. Give `type` (class name) or a `module` handle.

capabilities.name: ksp.module.get
capabilities.title: ksp.module.get
capabilities.description: Reads field values of one part module by handle (m:<partPid>:<index>:<Class>, from ksp.vessel.get depth 2 or ksp.query).

capabilities.name: ksp.query
capabilities.title: ksp.query
capabilities.description: Bulk read with one selector instead of many calls (04 §2): vessels (active, loaded, handles, nameLike, type), optional parts and modules (type), and the fields to read. Vessel fields: name, handle, type, situation, body, lat, lon, altitude, heightFromTerrain, srfSpeed, obtSpeed, verticalSpeed, horizontalSrfSpeed, heading, pitch, roll, course, mach, geeForce, dynamicPressurekPa, staticPressurekPa, atmDensity, externalTemperature, mass, missionTime, partCount, crewCount, currentStage, loaded, packed, landed, splashed, isActive, controllable, ctrlState.mainThrottle, ctrlState.pitch, ctrlState.yaw, ctrlState.roll, ctrlState.wheelThrottle, ctrlState.wheelSteer, actionGroups.sas, actionGroups.rcs, actionGroups.gear, actionGroups.brakes, actionGroups.lights. Module fields are the module's KSPField names (see ksp.module.describe). aggregate: perVessel (one row per vessel; module fields reduced with `reduce`), perModule or perPart.

select.description: Selector (04 §2): vessels, optional parts and modules.

vessels.description: Which vessels. All conditions must match; omit to select every loaded vessel.

loaded.description: only loaded vessels (true) or only unloaded ones (false)

nameLike.description: glob on the vessel name, e.g. "DDG*"

type.description: KSP vessel types, e.g. Ship, Plane, Probe

parts.description: Which parts (only when modules or part fields are wanted).

nameLike.description: glob on the part name (config name)

modules.description: Which part modules. Fields are then read from each module (Tier 0 KSPFields).

type.description: module class names, e.g. ModuleHullBreach, MissileFire

fields.description: Fields to read. Vessel fields (altitude, srfSpeed, ctrlState.mainThrottle, ... see ksp.query description) or module KSPField names when modules are selected; prefix with "vessel." to read a vessel field per module row.

reduce.description: how perVessel combines several modules' numeric values

cursor.description: opaque cursor from a previous result's "cursor" to get the next page

format.description: "compact" = a few readable text lines (best for LLMs), "json" = structured

capabilities.name: ksp.vessel.get
capabilities.title: ksp.vessel.get
capabilities.description: Reads one vessel. depth 0: summary (name, situation, speed, altitude, heading, throttle, parts, crew, controllable, BDArmory weapon manager / AI present); depth 1: + parts (handle, name, title, modules); depth 2: + module handles. Alias ksp.read. Use vessel:"active" for the vessel the player flies.

vessel.description: Vessel: a handle like "v:3281937421", an exact vessel name, or "active" for the vessel the player flies.

format.description: "compact" = a few readable text lines (best for LLMs), "json" = structured

capabilities.name: ksp.vessels.list
capabilities.title: ksp.vessels.list
capabilities.description: Lists vessels with handle, name, type, situation, body, lat/lon/altitude, state (live, packed, unloaded), parts, crew, surface speed and whether it is the active vessel. Debris is excluded unless includeDebris. Paged: use `cursor`.

loaded.description: only loaded (true) or only unloaded (false) vessels

cursor.description: opaque cursor from a previous result's "cursor" to get the next page

format.description: "compact" = a few readable text lines (best for LLMs), "json" = structured

capabilities.name: permissions.get
capabilities.title: permissions.get
capabilities.description: The effective permission decision for this session: for one capability (allow/ask/deny with the matched rule), or a summary of levels.

capabilities.name: permissions.request
capabilities.title: permissions.request
capabilities.description: Asks the human in game to grant a capability for this session. Your reason is shown labelled as AI-supplied text. Returns {status: granted|denied|timeout, scope}. Nothing over the wire can change permissions without the human.

capabilities.name: rec.get_file
capabilities.title: rec.get_file
capabilities.description: Reads a chunk (up to 1 MB) of a file under Skizzy/logs or Skizzy/screenshots, base64 encoded. Loop with offset until eof.

path.description: path relative to the KSP folder, e.g. Skizzy/logs/2026-11-08/climb.csv

capabilities.name: rec.log.list
capabilities.title: rec.log.list
capabilities.description: Lists running and recently stopped logs with path, rate, rows, bytes and state.

capabilities.name: rec.log.start
capabilities.title: rec.log.start
capabilities.description: Starts logging fields to CSV or JSONL (12 §1.1) at a fixed rate or on change, from a ksp.query-style selector. Writes Skizzy/logs/<date>/<name>.<csv|jsonl> under the KSP folder with columns ut, frame, wallUtc, vessel, vesselName (+ part, module for perModule) and the fields. Returns {log, path, columns}. Stop with rec.log.stop.

name.description: log name, used as the file name

select.description: Selector (04 §2): vessels, optional parts and modules.

vessels.description: Which vessels. All conditions must match; omit to select every loaded vessel.

loaded.description: only loaded vessels (true) or only unloaded ones (false)

nameLike.description: glob on the vessel name, e.g. "DDG*"

type.description: KSP vessel types, e.g. Ship, Plane, Probe

parts.description: Which parts (only when modules or part fields are wanted).

nameLike.description: glob on the part name (config name)

modules.description: Which part modules. Fields are then read from each module (Tier 0 KSPFields).

type.description: module class names, e.g. ModuleHullBreach, MissileFire

fields.description: Fields to read. Vessel fields (altitude, srfSpeed, ctrlState.mainThrottle, ... see ksp.query description) or module KSPField names when modules are selected; prefix with "vessel." to read a vessel field per module row.

rateHz.description: samples per second of game time

onChange.description: write a row only when a value changes by more than deadband (rateHz then caps the check rate)

maxMB.description: stop when the file reaches this size

capabilities.name: rec.log.stop
capabilities.title: rec.log.stop
capabilities.description: Stops a log started with rec.log.start and closes its file. Returns the path, row count and bytes.

log.description: log id "log:N" or the log name

capabilities.name: rec.log.tail
capabilities.title: rec.log.tail
capabilities.description: Returns the last n rows of a log (running or stopped) as compact text or JSON.

format.description: "compact" = a few readable text lines (best for LLMs), "json" = structured
